configurePresets.name: qt-6.11
configurePresets.description: Pins the Qt installed under /opt by the Qt online installer. Without this, find_package(Qt6 6.2) is also satisfied by the distro Qt (6.4.2 in /usr) and the chosen version depends on search order.

configurePresets.name: release
configurePresets.description: This is also the .deb packaging preset: CMakeLists.txt bundles this build's own Qt 6.11 libraries/plugins into the package (see the Install rules section), rather than linking whatever Qt6 the distro ships.

configurePresets.name: system-qt
configurePresets.description: Builds against the distro Qt in /usr. No longer used for .deb packaging (see the release preset) -- kept only for reproducing/comparing the system-Qt-specific bugs documented in BUILDINFO.md's Known issues section.

configurePresets.name: qt-6.11-windows
configurePresets.description: Pins the Qt 6.11.2 MinGW kit installed by the Qt Online Installer under C:/Qt, and the Ninja/MinGW toolchain installed alongside it under C:/Qt/Tools. Mirrors the Linux qt-6.11 base preset's CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH pinning above, for the same reason: find_package(Qt6 6.2) would otherwise resolve ambiguously if more than one Qt install were ever present.

configurePresets.name: windows-mingw
configurePresets.description: Native Windows build against the Qt Online Installer's Qt 6.11.2 MinGW 13.1.0 kit -- built and run directly on Windows, not cross-compiled. First-cut preset added to establish a Windows build baseline; the resulting build is otherwise unverified beyond configure+build succeeding -- see docs/windows-port-audit.md for what's actually been checked.

configurePresets.name: windows-mingw-release
configurePresets.description: Release variant of windows-mingw, for packaging -- same kit/toolchain, mirrors the Linux debug/release preset split above.
